# Registry of verified results {#sec-registry-fundamentals-of-theoretical-physics}

Every claim of the book with its Lean declaration and its verification level. A **certificate** is a proof whose data a Veriphy recipe found in Sage and whose proof the Lean kernel checked. A **kernel-checked test** is a check of the claim's Lean statement at instances chosen by Sage, each checked by the kernel by computation alone, used where no certificate is feasible. An **oracle test** is an evaluation of the claim at instances in exact or interval arithmetic by Sage. A **pending** claim is proved in Lean and awaits its certificate or test. Chapters whose claims are not yet formalised are listed with their number of blocks.
